name: Card
summary: Present related content in a bordered, filled, or elevated surface.

useWhen: Grouping related content, metadata, and actions into a single surface.
Making a whole item selectable or activatable as one control, with Card.Button.
avoidWhen: Dense rows and columns of data; use Table.
A section the user expands and collapses; use Disclosure.
Navigating to another page from the card; use Link inside Card.Root.

obligations: Card.Button is the interactive alternate root and exposes selected and pending state.

behavior: Card.Button is the interactive alternate root: a button that makes the whole card one control.
Card.Button reports selected as aria-pressed, and sets no pressed state when selected is not given.
pending on Card.Button suppresses activation and keeps it focusable; disabled applies the native disabled attribute.
A pending submit Card.Button does not submit its form by click or by Enter in a field; the application sets and clears pending around its own work.
A server-rendered pending submit Card.Button is disabled until it hydrates, so it is not focusable until then.
A script that calls requestSubmit with a pending submit Card.Button as the submitter is application code and is not blocked.
A native button cannot contain interactive elements, so buttons and links do not nest inside Card.Button.
Card.Header, Card.Body, and Card.Footer are div elements, not headings; a heading is the application's own element.
accessibility: Card.Button is the interactive alternate root and exposes selected and pending state.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
